context: Tests that real Microsoft/Entra sign-in setup for a dedicated customer happens as a distinct deploy-stage step (deploy.md D.6.5), right before merge, not during the local run and not skipped when going live.

checklist.name: Recognizes real sign-in setup is needed now
checklist.description: The agent identifies that going live requires setting up real Entra sign-in, and does not treat it as already done or skip it.

checklist.name: Walks through actual Entra app registration steps
checklist.description: The agent guides the customer through registering their own Entra app and placing the tenant/client id into wrangler.toml vars and the client secret into the Secrets Store/.secrets.

checklist.name: Confirms auth bypass is not left on for production
checklist.description: The agent confirms DISABLE_AUTHENTICATION is not enabled for production before proceeding to merge/deploy.

checklist.name: Does not conflate with local-run auth bypass
checklist.description: The agent does not suggest this should have been set up during the local run, and does not imply the local no-login bypass is equivalent to real production auth.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal step ids, or the words shared/dedicated/deployTarget/scopeChoice, are shown to the customer.
